boot_drive.precondition: boot parameter 5 reset to 'No override' before the run, so the result discriminates

controller_media_capability_as_reported.note: local_media_support 0 and sd_media 0 are the controller's own answers: this firmware does not expose BMC-resident image storage, so the board's eMMC cannot hold a boot image for virtual media. remote_media_support 1 is what makes the route below possible.

delivery_route: NFS share on 192.168.1.188:/srv/bmc -> MegaRAC remote-media client -> virtual CD -> host UEFI

host_side_acceptance_marker.why_this_is_the_marker: a nonzero redirection_status proves a media session; only output from the booted program proves the artifact executed on the host
